generated_content.title: Fox Developing Two-Hour Remake of 'The Rocky Horror Picture Show' for Small Screen
generated_content.situation: Fox is developing a two-hour remake of the 1975 cult classic 'The Rocky Horror Picture Show' for the small screen, directed, executive-produced, and choreographed by Kenneth Ortega.
